# Ascendrow

> A technology and growth agency. Paid ads, SEO, GEO (AI answer optimisation),
> branding, web design and CRM automation run as one system by three founders.

Ascendrow makes businesses visible on Google, memorable on social, and
recommended in AI answers (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini). Clients talk
to the founders directly; site, ads and brand are built by the same team.

## Services

- Paid media: Google Ads, Meta Ads, LinkedIn Ads, YouTube, Reddit — built
  around who actually converts, measured on one model.
- Organic growth: SEO for page-one rankings; GEO / AEO so the business is
  named inside AI-assistant answers.
- Web and conversion: websites and landing pages designed around the buying
  decision; UI/UX that removes friction; CRO.
- Brand and design: identity, positioning, messaging, design systems.
- Automation and CRM: every lead scored, routed and answered automatically.
- Social media: content that earns attention before buyers are ready.
